hero.title: OSAI+ Certification Guidelines
hero.description: Learn everything about the OSAI+ (Offensive Security AI) certification including eligibility, exam structure, domains, prerequisites, certification process, benefits and frequently asked questions.

introduction.title: Introduction
paragraphs: The Offensive Security AI (OSAI+) Certification is designed for professionals who want to validate their practical knowledge in Artificial Intelligence security, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Injection, AI Red Teaming and Enterprise AI Security.
The certification focuses on real-world offensive techniques against AI applications while also teaching mitigation strategies, secure deployment practices and defensive controls.
Unlike traditional multiple-choice certifications, OSAI+ emphasizes hands-on learning and practical security assessments.

examInformation.title: OSAI+ Certification Exam Information
examInformation.description: The OSAI+ examination evaluates a candidate's practical knowledge of offensive AI security, AI application testing, Prompt Injection, LLM Security and Enterprise AI Security.
importantNotes: Basic cyber security knowledge is recommended.
Understanding of networking fundamentals is helpful.
Hands-on AI security practice is strongly encouraged.
Stable internet connection is required for online examination.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about the OSAI+ certification.

questions.question: Is OSAI+ a practical certification?
questions.answer: Yes. The certification is heavily focused on practical offensive AI security exercises.

questions.question: Do I need prior AI experience?
questions.answer: No. Basic cybersecurity knowledge is enough, although familiarity with AI concepts is helpful.

questions.question: Is the certification valid for life?
questions.answer: Yes. OSAI+ certification currently has lifetime validity.

questions.question: Can beginners apply?
questions.answer: Yes. Anyone with basic networking and cybersecurity knowledge can join.

questions.question: Will I get lab access?
questions.answer: Yes. Students receive guided hands-on lab access throughout the training.
